title: Detailed paint palette
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Wooden palette body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="55" rx="40" ry="30" fill="#D4A056"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="55" rx="40" ry="30" fill="none" stroke="#E8BC7A" stroke-width="3"/>
  
  <!-- Thumb hole -->
  <ellipse cx="68" cy="68" rx="9" ry="8" fill="#2A1A3A"/>
  <ellipse cx="68" cy="68" rx="9" ry="8" fill="none" stroke="#8B6B3E" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  
  <!-- Paint blobs -->
  <!-- Red -->
  <ellipse cx="26" cy="38" rx="8" ry="6" fill="#FF3B3B"/>
  <ellipse cx="24" cy="36" rx="3" ry="2" fill="#FF8080"/>
  
  <!-- Orange -->
  <ellipse cx="42" cy="32" rx="7.5" ry="6" fill="#FF8C1A"/>
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="30" rx="2.5" ry="1.8" fill="#FFB866"/>
  
  <!-- Yellow -->
  <ellipse cx="56" cy="34" rx="7" ry="5.5" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <ellipse cx="54" cy="32" rx="2.5" ry="1.8" fill="#FFEE99"/>
  
  <!-- Green -->
  <ellipse cx="70" cy="40" rx="7" ry="5.5" fill="#2ECC40"/>
  <ellipse cx="68" cy="38" rx="2.5" ry="1.8" fill="#7FE88A"/>
  
  <!-- Blue -->
  <ellipse cx="30" cy="54" rx="7.5" ry="6" fill="#1E90FF"/>
  <ellipse cx="28" cy="52" rx="2.5" ry="1.8" fill="#7CC4FF"/>
  
  <!-- Purple -->
  <ellipse cx="46" cy="58" rx="7" ry="5.5" fill="#B44FFF"/>
  <ellipse cx="44" cy="56" rx="2.5" ry="1.8" fill="#D699FF"/>
  
  <!-- Pink -->
  <ellipse cx="60" cy="58" rx="6.5" ry="5" fill="#FF69B4"/>
  <ellipse cx="58" cy="56" rx="2.2" ry="1.6" fill="#FFA8D4"/>
  
  <!-- Cyan -->
  <ellipse cx="34" cy="68" rx="6.5" ry="5" fill="#00E5D0"/>
  <ellipse cx="32" cy="66" rx="2.2" ry="1.6" fill="#66FFF0"/>
  
  <!-- White -->
  <ellipse cx="48" cy="72" rx="7" ry="5.5" fill="#F0F0F0"/>
  <ellipse cx="46" cy="70" rx="2.5" ry="1.8" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  
  <!-- Magenta blob -->
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="70" rx="6" ry="5" fill="#FF44CC"/>
  <ellipse cx="60" cy="68" rx="2" ry="1.5" fill="#FF99E6"/>
  
  <!-- Paintbrush resting on palette -->
  <line x1="14" y1="90" x2="78" y2="22" stroke="#A0714A" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="14" y1="90" x2="20" y2="84" stroke="#8B5E3C" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Brush ferrule -->
  <rect x="72" y="24" width="10" height="5" rx="1" fill="#C0C0C0" transform="rotate(-42 77 26.5)"/>
  <!-- Brush tip -->
  <ellipse cx="84" cy="16" rx="5" ry="4" fill="#FF3B3B" transform="rotate(-42 84 16)"/>
  <ellipse cx="83" cy="15" rx="2" ry="1.5" fill="#FF8080" transform="rotate(-42 83 15)"/>
  
  <!-- Small paint splatter dots -->
  <circle cx="20" cy="46" r="1.5" fill="#FF8C1A"/>
  <circle cx="38" cy="42" r="1.2" fill="#2ECC40"/>
  <circle cx="52" cy="44" r="1.3" fill="#1E90FF"/>
  <circle cx="66" cy="50" r="1.2" fill="#FF69B4"/>
  <circle cx="24" cy="62" r="1.1" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <circle cx="40" cy="76" r="1.3" fill="#B44FFF"/>
</svg>
